canonical_data: workspace and worktree state plus orchestration runs, tasks, and inter-agent messages in a local database
strengths: Failure semantics are engineered rather than assumed, keeping an unverifiable verdict distinct from a confirmed exit
The terminal daemon outlives the application, so agent sessions survive a runtime restart or upgrade
Telemetry is enumerated field by field with three independent opt-outs, and the product has no account system
weaknesses: The inter-agent orchestration layer is gated behind an experimental setting and is absent from the project readme
The main runtime module is a single file of more than forty thousand lines against a repository-wide line-count ratchet
Open issues and pull requests both exceed two thousand, indicating triage is not keeping pace with the daily release cadence
why_it_matters: Runs any terminal coding agent as a supervised process under one application, making parallel agent work reviewable rather than merely concurrent.
